enabled.description: When false, the picker is display-only: all interaction (day clicks, month nav, time/date inputs, presets, clear) is disabled and the component is dimmed. The current selection is still shown.

display.description: 'inline' = the calendar is always visible. 'popover' = a small trigger field shows the selected range and opens the calendar in a floating panel when clicked.

placeholder.description: Trigger text shown when no range is selected.

closeOnSelect.description: Close the popover automatically once a complete range (or a preset) is chosen.

dateFormat.description: Date pattern for the trigger text (tokens: YYYY, YY, MM, M, DD, D). The 24h time is appended automatically and trimmed to the granularity: none for 'day', HH:mm for 'hour'/'minute', HH:mm:ss for 'second'.

disableDates.description: Which dates are muted/non-clickable. 'past': dates before today are muted (forward-only booking). 'future': dates after today are muted (historical selection). 'none': nothing muted.

dateBounds.description: Absolute calendar limits — the earliest/latest dates that can be selected.

earliest.description: Earliest selectable date 'YYYY-MM-DD' (blank = no lower limit; defaults to today in 'past' mode).

latest.description: Latest selectable date 'YYYY-MM-DD' (blank = no upper limit; defaults to today in 'future' mode).

spanDays.description: How long the selected range may be, in whole days (distinct from dateBounds, which limits WHICH dates).

min.description: Minimum range length in days (0 = no minimum; same-day allowed). Closer end days are disabled while selecting.

max.description: Maximum range length in days (0 = no maximum). Farther end days are disabled while selecting.

granularity.description: Time precision. 'day' hides the time pickers and uses whole days (start of start-day to end of end-day). 'hour'/'minute'/'second' show start/end time pickers at that precision.

durationLabelThresholdHours.description: Controls output.durationLabel only: spans at/above this many hours show as whole days ('3 days'); shorter spans show as elapsed time ('6h 30m').

weekStart.description: Day the week starts on (affects the calendar's weekday columns).

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. 'Europe/Brussels', 'UTC') a picked time is interpreted in. Blank = the browser/session-local zone. Drives the offset in output.startDateTime/endDateTime and the absolute output.*EpochMs.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale (e.g. 'nl-BE', 'fr-FR') for the month label and weekday headers. Blank = the browser default. Week start is still controlled by weekStart.

layout.description: Which layout to show. 'auto' picks responsively from the rendered size using 'breakpoints'. Force one with: 'compact' (date fields only), 'oneMonth' (single calendar), 'twoMonths' (two calendars side by side).

breakpoints.description: Size thresholds used only when layout = 'auto'.

compactBelowWidth.description: Use the compact layout when the rendered width (px) is below this.

compactBelowHeight.description: Use the compact layout when the rendered height (px) is below this.

twoMonthsAboveWidth.description: Use the two-month layout when the rendered width (px) is at or above this.

showClear.description: Show the 'Clear' button that resets the selection.

showPresets.description: Show the quick-range preset buttons (configured by 'presets').

presets.description: Quick-range buttons. Each item is a 'rolling' window (amount*unit from now; direction follows disableDates) or a 'calendar' period ('this*'/'last*', snapped to boundaries). Presets whose range breaks dateBounds or spanDays are disabled.

label.description: Button text. For a rolling preset, a leading 'Last' is shown as 'Next' when it rolls forward.

type.description: Which group below applies: 'rolling' (a window from now) or 'calendar' (a period snapped to boundaries). The other group is ignored.

rolling.description: Used when type = 'rolling': a window of amount*unit from now (direction follows disableDates).

amount.description: How many units the window spans from now.

calendar.description: Used when type = 'calendar': a period snapped to calendar boundaries.

period.description: 'this*' = period-to-date (start to end of today); 'last*' = the full previous period. Week periods honour weekStart.

labels.description: Override the UI text (for translation or branding). Each value defaults to the built-in English text.

startDate.description: Label for the start-date field (compact layout).

endDate.description: Label for the end-date field (compact layout).

selectRange.description: Footer text shown when no range is selected.

invalidRange.description: Footer text shown when the selected range is invalid.

sameDay.description: Duration label for a single-day range (day granularity).

previousMonth.description: Accessible label for the previous-month arrow.

nextMonth.description: Accessible label for the next-month arrow.

selection.description: The current selection (date + time-of-day parts). Two-way: set these to pre-select a range.

startTimeSec.description: Start time-of-day as seconds since midnight (0 = 00:00:00).

endTimeSec.description: End time-of-day as seconds since midnight (86399 = 23:59:59).

output.description: Derived results written by the component (bind to these).

startDateTime.description: OUTPUT: start instant as ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-06-25T09:00:00+02:00' (offset per config.timezone).

endDateTime.description: OUTPUT: end instant as ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-06-25T17:00:00+02:00' (offset per config.timezone).

startEpochMs.description: OUTPUT: start instant as epoch milliseconds (absolute UTC). Ideal for historian/tag queries.

endEpochMs.description: OUTPUT: end instant as epoch milliseconds (absolute UTC).

durationDays.description: OUTPUT: whole calendar days between start and end (0 = same day).

durationHours.description: OUTPUT: full span in hours (endDateTime - startDateTime).

durationLabel.description: OUTPUT: pre-formatted span for display, e.g. '3 days' or '6h 30m' (see config.durationLabelThresholdHours).

isValid.description: OUTPUT: true when both endpoints are set, end is after start, and the span is within spanDays.
